name: agent-suggest-card-stack

frames.best_why: Both cards are fully drawn and the mixed bar's green share is at its largest, with no cursor in the way.

tagline: Stacked agent report cards with green and red progress bars and Apply changes.
summary: Two overlapping cards summarise an AI agent's suggestions: a header with a count and title, two file rows with a bot badge, and two progress bars. The second bar splits green and red to show passed and failed work.
appearance: Two dark rounded cards offset on top of each other on black. The back card shows a green count pill, "Agent suggestions" and an issue number; the front card has two rows with a sparkle icon, filename, small "bot" pill and two ribbon progress bars.
behaviour: The top bar sits full green while the lower mixed bar grows its green passed share against a red remainder across the clip. Nothing else moves, and the Apply changes label is only drawn text.
demo_content: 3 Agent suggestions, Update auth config, Fix type errors, Apply changes.
use_when: An AI coding agent finishes a task and needs a compact summary of changes with a commit action.
avoid_when: The text sits inside a fixed-size SVG with fixed coordinates, so long filenames and translation will clip.
customise: Width, height, header title and badge, suggestions array, commit label, logo icon and dozens of colour tokens are props.
weight_why: A static SVG with a couple of shadow filters; no script or loop.

a11y.note: The Apply changes control is SVG text, not a button, and the graphic exposes only an SVG title to assistive tech.

props.name: suggestions
props.default: [{ id: '1', title: 'Vercel', progress: 8, status: 'success' }, { id: '2', title: 'Vercel', progress: 8, status: 'mixed', mixedProgress: { success: 92, error: 8 } }]

issues: The Apply changes button is drawn as SVG text with no handler, so it looks active but is inert.
polish_why: Tight, believable agent UI with crisp SVG bars; the commit label is inert.
title: Agent Suggest Card Stack
